name: skeft-qa
description: QA review agents + the autonomous-development harness for the SK_EFT_Hawking physics project. Fresh-context reviewers ask, in turn, whether a draft renders, whether it is backed, whether it is wrong, and whether it lands; the authoring skill shares its prohibited-pattern reference with the prose reviewer so a rule cannot drift between writing and review. The dev-harness keeps native /goal loops on-track across compactions (SessionStart re-injection, an AskUserQuestion guard that redirects to a coach rather than stalling, PreCompact durable staging, marker teardown) and guards web egress fail-closed against a denylist plus a scholarly-domain whitelist. Skills cover loop launch and posture, in-loop development, mechanical sync, wave close, and the off-hot-loop process harvest. The component roster is deliberately not enumerated here: it is auto-discovered from the tree, documented in README.md, and pinned by tests/test_plugin_surface.py, so this description cannot go stale as components are added.
